text: Sprinkling a few akshatas on the clay Ganapati with a flower, recite this verse inviting the Lord into your home.
From this moment he is present in the murti — the offerings that follow are simply the honours you would give a beloved guest.
శ్రీ వరసిద్ధి వినాయక స్వామిన్ ఆవాహయామి స్థాపయామి పూజయామి ॥
